about: The Kartipelago material library, shown in Blender's Material Browser. Each material is a small repeating image plus a suggested driving surface. The surface is only a default: in Blender you can give the same image any surface (see docs/materials.md). Textures are original prototypes made for this project (starter_manifest.json), MIT like the rest of the repo.
surfaceIds: Surfaces are the game's ids from assets/data/surfaces.json (road, dirt, grass, sand, water, lava, wall...).

themes.name: Mirror Lake
themes.description: Golden dirt roads, bright grass, warm layered cliffs, clear blue-green water

themes.name: Bone Canyon
themes.description: Reddish clay roads, striped sandstone cliffs, scree and dry clay

themes.name: Jungle Cascade
themes.description: Mossy stone, old masonry, leafy ground and soft green light, ringed by misty jungle hills

themes.name: Ember Volcano
themes.description: Dark ash roads, basalt walls, glowing lava, scorched slag

themes.name: River Valley
themes.description: Sunny orange dirt roads, bright grass, blue water, palms and wooden bridges, under a sunny painted sky

themes.name: Fossil Swamp
themes.description: Misty green water, slick mud, old paving, giant bones and glowing caps

themes.name: Volcano Dusk
themes.description: A glowing red-orange evening under a smoking volcano (uses the Ember Volcano textures)

themes.name: Beach Party
themes.description: White-gold sand, a turquoise sea, palms, bright party colours and a high midday sun

themes.name: Frost Citadel
themes.description: Moonlit snow and ice, blue-lavender fog and weathered stone ruins lit by golden firelight

themes.name: Bonebog Swamp
themes.description: A living swamp at golden hour: vivid murky greens, mossy stone, old timber, ancient bone and warm torchlight under a vast canopy

themes.name: Volcanic Apocalypse
themes.description: A smoke-filtered blood-red sunset over erupting volcanoes: black obsidian, charred ground, molten lava and firelight

themes.name: Summit Pass
themes.description: A brilliant sunny day in the snowy mountains: dazzling snow, turquoise ice, steaming hot springs, glowing ice caves and giant trees

themes.name: Hearthglow
themes.description: A Christmas village on a snowy evening: a purple and blue twilight full of stars, warm golden windows and lanterns, coloured lights, deep snow and frozen water

themes.name: Aurora Rift
themes.description: A fractured glacier under the northern lights: deep blue ice, dark indigo rock, glowing cyan and violet crystals, warm amber lanterns and a starry night alive with aurora

themes.name: Canyon Dash
themes.description: A clear desert afternoon turning golden: layered red, orange and cream sandstone, deep blue-violet canyon shadows, a turquoise river and a saturated blue sky with big white clouds

themes.name: Oasis Haven
themes.description: A perfect summer afternoon at a desert oasis resort: an intense blue sky with big white clouds, high bright sun, brilliant turquoise water, cream sandstone with royal-blue domes and gold, lush palms and flowers, and golden dunes and red mesas beyond

themes.name: Dry Gulch Ghost Town
themes.description: A haunted frontier mining town under an enormous full moon: deep violet and indigo sky, red-rock mesas in moonlight, weathered wooden buildings glowing with warm orange lanterns, and an abandoned mine pouring out an eerie spectral green

themes.name: Impact Depths
themes.description: A blazing desert noon over a smoking asteroid crater, and under it a descending world: warm ochre caverns of cyan and violet crystal, a sunlit prehistoric jungle round a turquoise lake, black volcanic depths of lava, a dragon's crimson lair and a glowing gold-and-magenta core

themes.name: Dragon Isles
themes.description: A sunlit kingdom of karst mountains in a turquoise lagoon: red-lacquered temples under blue and gold tiled roofs, white waterfalls, pink blossom, golden lanterns and red festival banners, distant peaks fading into soft blue haze

themes.name: Dragon Canyon
themes.description: The dragon kingdom's desert frontier at golden hour: towering red-orange sandstone canyons, turquoise rivers and white waterfalls far below, cliffside fortresses under blue and jade roofs, red imperial banners, flaring braziers, pink and violet sunset clouds and a warm haze over the distant spires

themes.name: Snow Dragon Pass
themes.description: The dragon kingdom's highest mountains in a blizzard: slate-grey peaks buried in snow, frozen turquoise waterfalls, blue ice caverns, snow-laden monasteries in whitewash and red, weathered red timber, imperial crimson banners and muted gold, warm orange lanterns in the villages and the citadel blazing gold high above

themes.name: Celestial Dragon Festival
themes.description: The dragon kingdom's sacred heart on the night of its greatest festival: a near-black sky full of stars, a crescent moon, karst islands over a glowing turquoise lagoon, thousands of warm red and gold lanterns, white and gold palaces under deep blue domes, golden astronomical rings, pink blossom, crimson and navy dragon banners, and fireworks

themes.name: Dragonspire Keep
themes.description: A dark-stone castle on its cliffs at sunset: grey-violet walls and slate spires, crimson dragon banners, torches and braziers, waterfalls into a mountain lake, a sea of cloud and snowy peaks beyond, and a red dragon on the highest tower

themes.name: Emberdeep Hold
themes.description: A dragon-ruled fortress built into a dark mountain on a stormy night: weathered sandstone towers and battlements over black rock, red dragon banners, torchlit halls of pillars, waterfalls down the chasms, lightning over the peaks, and a red dragon on its hoard of gold

themes.name: Emerald Kingdom
themes.description: An overgrown jungle castle and its ruins in late-afternoon sun: mossy carved stone, giant trees and roots, green banners with a gold spiral, turquoise rivers and falls, glowing green crystals in the caves, and a green dragon on the old watchtower

themes.name: Moonstone Kingdom
themes.description: A moonlit violet kingdom under a huge pale moon: moonstone walls and violet spires, purple crescent banners, a lake glowing blue, floating islands with castles and falls, crystal caverns, an observatory with a great armillary sphere, and a purple dragon on the palace tower
